name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or feature for Taskify
title: "[FEATURE] "

---

### Is your feature request related to a problem?
Describe the problem you run into when using the app.

### What is your proposed solution?
Explain what you would like to happen and how it should look or work.

### Alternatives considered
Describe any workarounds or alternatives you have tried.

### Visual ideas or mockups
If you have a sketch, mockup, or screenshot of an interface you like, drop it here.

### Would you like to build this yourself?
Let us know if you want to submit a pull request (PR) for this feature. Both traditional code and AI vibe-coding contributions are welcome.
